package worker

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/internal/offlinejson"
)

func TestRecoveredDisableNativeContextClosedAndBounded(t *testing.T) {
	valid := `{"url":"https://example.test/guide","id":"parent-1"}`
	source, err := decodeRecoveredDisableSource(valid)
	if err != nil || source.URL != "https://example.test/guide" || source.ID != "parent-1" {
		t.Fatalf("valid native context refused: %+v %v", source, err)
	}
	for _, raw := range []string{
		``, `null`, `{}`, `[]`,
		`{"url":"https://example.test/guide"}`,
		`{"url":"https://example.test/guide","id":null}`,
		`{"URL":"https://example.test/guide","id":"parent-1"}`,
		`{"url":"https://example.test/guide","id":"parent-1","clientID":"forged"}`,
		`{"url":"https://example.test/guide","id":"parent-1","id":"forged"}`,
		`{"url":"https://example.test/guide","id":"parent-1"} {}`,
		`{"url":"https://example.test/guide","id":"bad id"}`,
		`{"url":"https://example.test/guide","id":"` + strings.Repeat("x", 65) + `"}`,
		`{"url":"https://example.test/` + strings.Repeat("x", 2048) + `","id":"parent-1"}`,
	} {
		if _, err := decodeRecoveredDisableSource(raw); err == nil {
			t.Errorf("accepted invalid native context %q", raw)
		}
	}
	var command Command
	if err := offlinejson.Decode([]byte(`{"version":1,"command":"disable-recovered","ownerPolicyID":"guide","runtimeID":"runtime","configurationID":"configuration","requestID":"request-1","clientID":"forged"}`), &command); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("authored command accepted a forged native sender ID")
	}
}

func TestRecoveredDisableSnapshotValidation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		pair   ioReply
		sender string
		want   string
	}{
		{"parent-and-real-helper", ioReply{Controlled: 2, ClientIDs: []string{"parent", "helper"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent", "helper", "uncontrolled"}}, "parent", ""},
		{"native-null-helper-not-reported-controlled", ioReply{Controlled: 1, ClientIDs: []string{"parent"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent", "helper"}}, "parent", ""},
		{"four-total", ioReply{Controlled: 4, ClientIDs: []string{"parent", "helper", "a", "b"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent", "helper", "a", "b"}}, "parent", ""},
		{"five-total", ioReply{Controlled: 5, ClientIDs: []string{"parent", "helper", "a", "b", "c"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent", "helper", "a", "b", "c"}}, "parent", "client-capacity"},
		{"other-worker-parent", ioReply{Controlled: 1, ClientIDs: []string{"other"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent", "other"}}, "parent", "sender-uncontrolled"},
		{"controlled-absent-from-visible", ioReply{Controlled: 2, ClientIDs: []string{"parent", "helper"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent"}}, "parent", "clients-unavailable"},
		{"duplicate-controlled", ioReply{Controlled: 2, ClientIDs: []string{"parent", "parent"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent"}}, "parent", "clients-unavailable"},
		{"duplicate-visible", ioReply{Controlled: 1, ClientIDs: []string{"parent"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent", "parent"}}, "parent", "clients-unavailable"},
		{"count-mismatch", ioReply{Controlled: 2, ClientIDs: []string{"parent"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent"}}, "parent", "clients-unavailable"},
		{"negative-count", ioReply{Controlled: -1}, "parent", "clients-unavailable"},
		{"invalid-controlled", ioReply{Controlled: 2, ClientIDs: []string{"parent", "bad id"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent", "bad id"}}, "parent", "clients-unavailable"},
		{"invalid-visible", ioReply{Controlled: 1, ClientIDs: []string{"parent"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent", "bad id"}}, "parent", "clients-unavailable"},
		{"invalid-sender", ioReply{Controlled: 1, ClientIDs: []string{"parent"}, VisibleIDs: []string{"parent"}}, "bad id", "clients-unavailable"},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := recoveredDisableClients(test.pair, test.sender); got != test.want {
				t.Fatalf("snapshot result %q, want %q", got, test.want)
			}
		})
	}
	visible := []string{"parent"}
	for i := 0; i < 256; i++ {
		visible = append(visible, "client-"+strings.Repeat("x", i%60))
	}
	if code := recoveredDisableClients(ioReply{Controlled: 1, ClientIDs: []string{"parent"}, VisibleIDs: visible}, "parent"); code != "clients-unavailable" {
		t.Fatalf("oversized visible inventory accepted: %q", code)
	}
}
